summary: Frozen single-factor prompt ablation (only prompts.system varies) on the audited parent harness. All four cells (M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN, each under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA and P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED) passed the constrained-decoding positive control 10/10, loaded, and recorded exactly 5 episodes. Every one of the 20 treatment/comparator episodes showed the identical parent failure mode: step-0 reveal-click succeeds (revealed_value=TARGET-42), then the model re-emits a click on the now-hidden #reveal-btn for every remaining step and never emits an answer action (answer_action_emission_rate=0/5 in all cells; task_success_rate=0/5 in all cells; parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 in all cells). The treatment prompt that supplies the task goal and action-schema enumeration therefore does NOT convert the step-0 reveal-click into a full click-then-answer completion. Per frozen decision_rule precedence: preflight PASS (rule 1); both candidate pairs run (rule 2a); both comparator cells are COMPLETE-and-VALID and match the parent anchor exactly (rule 2e REPLICATION_ANCHOR_EXACT); neither treatment cell clears (rule 2h TREATMENT_FAILS_BAR); at least one COMPLETE treatment cell exists and none cleared (rule 3) -> OUTCOME=FALSIFIES, status=COMPLETE.

observations: Preflight (rule 1) passed every frozen check: PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5 task_success; NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION parseable 0.0 / success 0.0; B-RANDOM-ACTION parseable 1.0 / task_success_rate 0.2 (<0.6); all five freeze_artifact sha256 matches; required stack imports OK; all three GGUF digest checks PASS (7B shard1 dfce12e3..., shard2 539cf93f..., 3B 626b4a66...; sizes 3993201344 / 689872288 / 2104932768).
All four model cells loaded (load_status=LOADED) and ran to completion (run_status=COMPLETE), each with the PC gate 10/10 and exactly 5 episode records: 4 COMPLETE, 0 EXCLUDED, 0 PARTIAL.

M-7B-QWEN under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA (goal + action schema supplied): every one of the 5 episodes emitted {"action":"click","selector":"#reveal-btn"} at step 0 (click_ok=true), the reveal fired (revealed_value=TARGET-42), then steps 1-4 each re-emitted the same click on the now-hidden button (click_ok=false) and no answer action was ever emitted; step_count=5 in all episodes; task_success=false 0/5.
M-7B-QWEN under P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED produced an identical trace structure (step-0 reveal-click, steps 1-4 hidden-button re-click, no answer action, 0/5 task_success), reproducing the parent anchor.

M-3B-QWEN under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA produced an identical trace structure (step-0 reveal-click with raw '{"action": "click", "selector": "#reveal-btn"}', steps 1-4 hidden-button re-click, no answer action, 0/5 task_success).
M-3B-QWEN under P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED produced an identical trace structure (0/5 task_success), reproducing the parent anchor.
answer_action_emission_rate (new metric) = 0.0 (0/5) in all four cells: no cell ever emitted a terminal answer action.

The only varied dimension between paired cells was prompts.system: the comparator overlay is byte-identical to the frozen parent harness_config.json (sha256 a9a6c54f...), and the treatment overlay (sha256 8283aae1...) differs from the parent only in prompts.system (verified programmatically; materialized_configs.json records diff_confined_to_prompts_system=true and overlay_is_parent_byte_identical=false for treatment, true for comparator).
The treatment system string (sha256 36a4240a...6) contains neither '#reveal-btn' nor 'TARGET-42', so the treatment positive path could not be an answer-leakage artifact.

PC-ORACLE-EPISODE drove the frozen real run_episode scorer 5/5 through a real browser against the served page, so the full click-then-answer completion path is registerable and the mechanical verification is live.

B-RANDOM-ACTION was run on the SERVED page (navigation repaired relative to the parent's about:blank defect); its realized task_success_rate was 0.2 (1/5) matching the design-time seed-42 simulation, with parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0.

Observed CPU-only inference cost: M-7B mean latency 6.22-6.24 s/call at mean 15.0 completion tokens; M-3B mean latency 2.73-2.74 s/call at mean 12.14 completion tokens (n_calls=35 per cell = 10 PC probes + 25 episode-step calls).

Frozen input integrity re-verified on disk at EXECUTE: request.json, spec.json, prereg.md and design_review.json match freeze.json.hashes; all five freeze_artifact hashes match freeze.json.artifact_hashes.
validity_notes: status=COMPLETE and outcome=FALSIFIES is a valid bounded scientific negative, not an infrastructure failure: preflight passed every gate, both models loaded, positive controls fired 10/10 in all four cells, and the scorer registered the full completion path 5/5 in PC-ORACLE-EPISODE.

The measurement transaction followed the frozen design exactly. The only new code authored at EXECUTE is the Appendix A controls driver, the section-4.2 materializer and the Appendix A.5 evaluator (all under research/intel); outcome-determining model invocation, parsing and scoring were executed by the unmodified frozen parent runner research/intel/run_exp_37982024058.py (sha256 2b5d5bb5...).

Deterministic protocol (temperature=0.0, per-episode seeds 42-46, llama_seed=42): all 5 episodes per cell were identical in trace structure, so there is zero within-cell variance; the 3/5 rule is the pre-declared adequacy rule for the capability gate, not a statistical threshold, and no variance estimate or p-value is reported.
Small n: 5 episodes per cell, 5 episodes per control. This is the frozen adequacy rule (parent audit VF-05), appropriate for a capability gate.

Bundled treatment / second-order attribution limit: P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA bundles (a) the goal sentence, (b) the action-schema enumeration, and (c) the grandparent's exact phrasing. This packet identifies the bundled 'goal/schema system prompt vs underspecified system prompt' effect (the Director's operational question); it does not decompose goal-only vs schema-only vs phrasing vs generic longer-prompt effects. That decomposition is out of scope and remains unresolved.

The comparator cells were collected unconditionally before any decision and are contemporaneous within-run pairs (same model, task, grammar, sampling, seeds, artifacts and code path; only prompts.system differs). Both comparators reproduced the frozen parent anchor exactly (REPLICATION_ANCHOR_EXACT: task_success_rate=0.0, parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0, answer_action_emission_rate=0.0), so the treatment negative is not attributable to run-level environment drift.

H1b attribution (PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED) is only defined for a clearing candidate; since no treatment cell cleared, attribution is not exercised and the comparators are descriptive anchor replications, not an attribution contrast for a positive.

Representation loss: state is the simplified text DOM (PAGE_TEXT/ELEMENTS/HISTORY). After the reveal ELEMENTS is empty and PAGE_TEXT contains TARGET-42, so the repeated hidden-button re-click is not attributable to missing page text. This is inherited unchanged from the parent and is a scope/limitation, not a confound for the prompt contrast.

Single-task, single-model-family scope: this is a capability gate on one minimal synthetic task in the Qwen2.5 3B-8B Q4_K_M class under this harness; failing it is bounded to that class/protocol and does not close other model classes, larger models, hosted endpoints or the Physics/other domains.

Packaging/provisioning deviation inherited from the parent: the frozen 7B single-file URL is HTTP 404; the same-repo, same-model, same-quant (Q4_K_M) split shards were re-downloaded and fail-closed digest-verified against raw/gguf_sha256.txt. No model or quantization substitution. Requirements provisioned at EXECUTE: llama-cpp-python 0.2.90 built from sdist into a venv (--system-site-packages), Playwright 1.63.0 with /usr/bin/google-chrome 154.0.8037.97 headless --no-sandbox.

GGUF byte-identity is verified by sha256 against the frozen parent receipts (download-time digests); the files live outside the repo at /tmp/opencode/gguf/ and are not durable repo artifacts, so their digests are recorded in preflight.json and provenance.json rather than as repo artifact entries.

mean_inference_latency_s and mean_completion_tokens are computed over all 35 model calls per cell (10 positive-control probes + 25 episode-step calls) and are descriptive CPU-only cost observables; they are not part of the decision rule.

No post-freeze design change, no prompt tuning after seeing outcomes, no model substitution, no weakening of the frozen decision rule. The frozen inputs were treated as immutable and re-verified after execution.
unresolved: The goal+schema treatment prompt did not convert the step-0 reveal-click into a completion; the mechanism is not decomposed. Whether supplying only the goal sentence, only the action-schema enumeration, a different phrasing, or a shorter/different representation would change the outcome is untested (second-order attribution limit).

Why both models re-emit a click on the now-hidden #reveal-btn across all remaining steps instead of answering, even when the goal sentence and terminal answer action are explicitly enumerated, remains an open behavioural question (small-model multi-step planning/state-tracking deficit vs residual prompt/harness effect).
Whether larger (14B+) or non-Qwen CPU-quantized GGUFs, or a hosted programmatic endpoint, clear the bar under this task is out of the frozen 3B-8B Qwen scope and untested.
H1b (PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED) was not exercised because no treatment cell cleared; a positive prompt effect remains unmeasured by this packet.
